name: xTool S1
notes: Enclosed diode laser with swappable modules (alias D2).
source: xTool Studio 1.9.11 device extension MD2 (exts/S1), read 2026-11-26. Work areas from the extension's processingArea table (per module watts). The extension only gives watts (power enum 0/2/3/10/20/40); 2 W and 3 W as infrared (they share positioning offsets, and the extension mentions an infrared laser module) and 10/20/40 W as blue diodes are not stated per module. Which operations each module can do is an assumption.
